name: review-cycle
description: Automated multi-agent code review cycle that spawns reviewers in parallel (plus Codex when available), applies fixes per CLAUDE.md policy, admits a commit only when a reviewer saw exactly what it records, and asks before a push, pull request, merge or release you did not request, unless you let it go further.

enabled.title: Commit gate
enabled.description: Refuse a commit unless a reviewer saw what it records, and stop at the step set in Stop before. Only you can change this, here in /config.

stopBefore.title: Stop before
stopBefore.description: The first step the agent asks you about unless you requested it: commit, push, open PR, merge, release, or never stop. Steps before it run without asking; a force push, a push to the default branch, a tag push, a remote delete, a merge with --admin and a comment on GitHub always ask. A project's .claude/settings.json can only stop earlier; .claude/settings.local.json can set any step. Only you can change this, here in /config.

prUpdates.title: Pull request updates
prUpdates.description: What the agent may do to a pull request already open, apart from Stop before. ask: nothing more than Stop before allows. push fixes: a push to a branch heading your own open, unapproved pull request in the repository it pushes to runs without asking, so a fix for CI or a review goes out, and is shown on screen. A first push, a push to the default branch, a force push (so a lower layer of a stack), a tag push, a branch a tool rebuilds (version, Renovate, Dependabot) and a pull request from a fork still ask, and nothing changes under claude -p. The fix's commit still follows Stop before: at commit, the agent asks for the commit first. push and reply: also replies to review threads a bot opened on that pull request, each naming its pushed fix commit, shown on screen with links. push, reply and resolve: also resolves those threads once a reply names the fix; nothing else resolves a thread. A thread a person opened, and a top-level comment, always ask. A project's .claude/settings.json can only ask more; .claude/settings.local.json can set any value. Only you can change this, here in /config.

nudge.title: Review nudge
nudge.description: When a turn leaves changes no reviewer has seen, have your next message remind the agent, out of your sight, to run /review-cycle:review first, unless its last message ends with a question mark. A project's .claude/settings.json can turn it off; .claude/settings.local.json can set it either way. Only you can change this, here in /config.

unaskedNotice.title: Unasked-step notice
unaskedNotice.description: Show a line on screen when a push, pull request, merge or release runs without your asking because Stop before allows it. The agent is told either way; a merge run now on a request to merge once ready is always shown. Only you can change this, here in /config.
